eventDetail.scope: The 7th International Conference on Communication, Computing, and Industry 6.0 is a global platform for the researchers to exchange research results and ideas on the Communication, Computing, and Industry 6.0. This conference aims to bring together experts from many sectors to create a linked ecosystem inspired by the sixth industrial revolution. C2I6-2025 aims to enhance industry-academic engagement and bridge the gap between the two by encouraging peer-reviewed paper submissions, keynotes, invited lectures, and panel discussions. The conference is also a great opportunity for students and researchers to improve their research skills.
